[[File:Focused_Uni-Directional_Sensor_Dish.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Focused Uni-Directional Sensor Dish]]
A '''focused uni-directional sensor dish''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that operated in a similar manner to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-based [[Dedicated energy receptor/Legends|dedicated energy receptor]]. The dishes maintained a tight, focused beam, relaying information on previously located targets. Due to the dish's small range of coverage, it was useless as an early detection sensor.
